The '''Uthuthma''' were an [[alien]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Jakku]]. They were described as having a "socket-[[eye]]d skull face" with a "[[tooth]]y [[Mouth|maw]]." They wore chains around their necks as scarves. [[Gazwin]] was a member of this species that was present on Jakku during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Aftermath" />
